newsitem.title: UK: Robertson to be new British defence secretary.
newsitem.headline: Robertson to be new British defence secretary.

text.p: Scotsman George Robertson will be named as Britain's new defence secretary, official sources said on Saturday.

The announcement came as something of a surprise, for Robertson had been the Labour party's Scottish affairs spokesman before the May 1 election. There was no immediate news of what would happen to David Clark, who had been the party's defence spokesman.
Robertson's time in charge of the Scottish portfolio was marred by abrupt policy changes.
But he was seen as a more impressive performer than Clark, widely regarded as being at risk when Prime Minister Tony Blair handed out cabinet posts.

Robertson had been tipped for a senior job and his move from Scottish affairs was inevitable after Donald Dewar, Labour's parliamentary manager up to the election, was given the Scottish office and the job of piloting laws to devolve power to Scotland through parliament.
